lines: Woh ishq jo hum se rooth gaya, ab us ka haal batayen kya?
couplets.en: What can we say now of the love that turned away from us?

lines: Koi mehr nahin, koi qahr nahin, phir sachcha sher sunayen kya?
couplets.en: With neither kindness nor cruelty, what true verse can we recite?

lines: Woh ishq jo hum se rooth gaya.
couplets.en: That love turned away from us.

lines: Ek hijr jo hum ko laahaq hai, taa der use dohrayen kya?
couplets.en: How long shall we speak of the parting that still weighs on us?

lines: Woh zahr jo dil mein utaar liya, phir us ke naaz uthayen kya?
couplets.en: Having taken that poison to heart, must we still indulge its whims?

lines: Koi mehr nahin, koi qahr nahin, phir sachcha sher sunayen kya?
couplets.en: With neither kindness nor cruelty, what true verse can we recite?

lines: Woh ishq jo hum se rooth gaya.
couplets.en: That love turned away from us.

lines: Ek aag gham-e-tanhai ki, jo saare badan mein phail gayi.
couplets.en: The grief of solitude caught fire and spread through the whole body.

lines: Jab jism hi saara jalta ho, phir daaman-e-dil ko bachayen kya?
couplets.en: When the whole body burns, how can we save even the hem of the heart?

lines: Koi mehr nahin, koi qahr nahin, phir sachcha sher sunayen kya?
couplets.en: With neither kindness nor cruelty, what true verse can we recite?

lines: Woh ishq jo hum se rooth gaya.
couplets.en: That love turned away from us.

lines: Hum naghma-sara kuchh ghazlon ke, hum surat-gar kuchh khwabon ke.
couplets.en: We are singers of a few ghazals and shapers of a few dreams.

lines: Be-jazba-e-shauq sunayen kya, koi khwab na ho to batayen kya?
couplets.en: What can we sing without longing, and what can we tell without a dream?

lines: Koi mehr nahin, koi qahr nahin, phir sachcha sher sunayen kya?
couplets.en: With neither kindness nor cruelty, what true verse can we recite?
